facts.fact: The University of Djibouti's AI research laboratory LaRIA held a workshop on 9 July 2026 exhibiting its AI projects, including cancer-cell detection and demonstrations of early-warning systems for disasters and epidemics.

The University of Djibouti's Faculty of Engineering hosted a scientific workshop on 9 July 2026, organised by its AI Research Laboratory (LaRIA), on research applications of AI in health, environment and climate resilience.
